bundle_summary: Two coherent directions emerge: (1) wine/bar-themed housewarming gifts for couples/hosts, supported by multiple alcohol-related customizable items and an occasion-specific audience term; (2) modern/unique home-decor signage suitable as housewarming gifts, centered on WiFi password signs and general modern/unique home decor phrases. Broad gift terms, baskets/boxes, and party cups are treated as ingredients; low-signal foreign-language variants are held.

hypotheses.concise_evidence: Multiple alcohol-related customizable product intents (wine stopper, tumbler, bottle label) co-occur with housewarming audience/occasion queries (for couple, gift basket).
hypotheses.label: Wine/bar-themed housewarming gifts for couples and hosts
likely_validation_surfaces: Etsy search results and top listings for wine-themed housewarming gifts
Autocomplete/co-search terms linking housewarming with wine/host gifts
Category filters for barware/wine accessories used as gifts
hypotheses.theme_identity_or_occasion: Housewarming gifts with wine/bar theme (labels, stoppers, tumblers)
hypotheses.uncertainty: Not all product formats are strictly POD; need to verify presence of printable/customized designs positioned specifically for housewarming.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: New homeowners and gift-givers seeking decor-forward gifts
hypotheses.concise_evidence: WiFi password sign aligns with modern/entryway signage; supported by demand for unique/modern home decor and common house-themed phrase ‘home sweet home’.
hypotheses.label: Modern/unique home-decor signage as housewarming gifts
likely_validation_surfaces: Etsy search pages for WiFi password signs and related decor

hypotheses.theme_identity_or_occasion: Modern/unique home decor with signage focus (e.g., WiFi password sign, Home Sweet Home) suitable for housewarming
hypotheses.uncertainty: Need to confirm enough sellers position these decor items explicitly as housewarming gifts, not just generic decor.
